answer: Reputation-weighted resource quotas. Each identity earns compute rights only by sustained useful output, tracked as a decaying umber score that a fresh identity cannot borrow or buy. Enforcement ties every request to that score, so a new identity starts near zero and rises along a slow spiral of demonstrated work, while an attacker must运营 many identities through the same costly ramp.
